description: This Java source file defines the TaxwareUTL class, which interfaces with the Taxware tax calculation system. It handles data file creation, preparing shipping and item data, invoking native libraries for tax calculations, and processing the returned data. The class manages tax adjustment records and outputs data files for external tax processing.

classes.name: TaxwareUTL
classes.description: A utility class for integrating with the Taxware tax calculation system, handling data file creation, processing, and communication with native libraries.

methods.name: TaxwareUTL

methods.description: Performs the tax calculation process by preparing data, invoking external tax calculation, and handling the output.
